caption: A fatty burger is flipped on a grill, and fat drips onto the coals and a flame flares up under the patty.

sa.check: A burger patty lies on a grill.
Fat drips from the patty onto the coals.
A flame flares up under the patty.
The flare dies back after a moment.
The order is flip, drip, flare.

pc.expect: The flare appears where the fat lands on the coals and dies back after a moment.
pc.fail: The flare appears before any fat has dripped; or fat drips onto the coals and nothing flares at all; or the flare appears at a part of the grill no fat reached; or the flare keeps growing with no more fat dripping.

pc.expect: The fat drips downward from the patty to the coals and the flames climb upward around the patty.
pc.fail: Fat drips upward from the patty; or a drip hangs in the air between patty and coals; or the flames point downward away from the patty; or the flames hang below the coals.

pc.expect: The flare only rises and then dies back and does not return with no more fat, and the patty's seared face does not return to raw.
pc.fail: The flare dies back and rises again with no fresh drip; or the patty's seared face turns back to raw pink where the flame licked it; or the flare shrinks and grows in turn with the patty still; or a burnt mark on the patty fades.

pc.expect: The fat leaves as thin drops that fall and sizzle, the patty stays a soft solid that dents under the tongs, and the bars stay rigid.
pc.fail: The fat leaves as a solid lump; or the patty flows off the bars as a liquid; or the patty shatters when flipped; or the grill bars bend under the patty.

pc.expect: One patty on one grill; the patty keeps its shape apart from the flip and the coals keep their number.
pc.fail: The patty vanishes; or a second patty appears; or the patty passes through the bars and out below; or a coal vanishes leaving no ash.

pc.expect: The grill's bars, the coals' bed and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The bars change spacing; or the coals rearrange where no fat fell; or the background changes between frames.

note: The patty browning as it cooks is chemistry and is not judged. Who flips the burger is not judged.
